title: No One Architecture Fits All: A Cross-Environment Evaluation of Hierarchical Red Team Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.00557v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous red team agents increasingly stress-test AI-enabled cyber defenses by planning strategy and executing multistage attacks. Reinforcement learning (RL) and large language models (LLMs) offer complementary mechanisms for the planning and execution such agents require, and prior work has combined them in hybrid hierarchies. Yet a given architecture is typically developed and evaluated within a single environment, leaving open whether an observed advantage reflects a generally stronger decision mechanism or merely alignment with a particular setting. We address this gap with a controlled cross-environment comparison of two homogeneous hierarchical red team architectures: an RL planner with an RL executor (RL+RL) and an LLM planner with an LLM executor (LLM+LLM). translated_title: 没有一种架构放之四海而皆准：分层红队智能体的跨环境评估
translated_abstract: 自主红队智能体日益通过规划策略和执行多阶段攻击，对AI赋能的网络防御进行压力测试。强化学习（RL）与大语言模型（LLM）为这类智能体所需的规划与执行提供了互补的机制，先前的工作已将二者结合在混合分层架构中。然而，某一给定架构通常仅在单一环境中进行开发和评估，这使得观察到的优势究竟反映了普遍更强的决策机制，还是仅仅与特定设置相契合，仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们通过对两种同构的分层红队架构进行受控跨环境比较来填补这一空白：RL规划器加RL执行器（RL+RL）以及LLM规划器加LLM执行器（LLM+LLM）。我们在CybORG CAGE-4以及两种网络规模的Cyberwheel环境中，针对专家级自主防御者，在统一破坏度量标准下对18种配置进行了评估。
tldr: 该论文通过在CybORG CAGE-4和Cyberwheel两个环境、18种配置下的受控跨环境比较，评估了RL+RL与LLM+LLM两种分层红队智能体架构，证明没有一种架构能在所有环境中都占优势。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a controlled cross-environment evaluation of RL+RL and LLM+LLM hierarchical red team agent architectures across CybORG CAGE-4 and Cyberwheel under 18 configurations, demonstrating that no single architecture dominates in all environments.
